newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Yields flat to higher at latest Saudi t-bill offer.
newsitem.headline: Yields flat to higher at latest Saudi t-bill offer.

text.p: Yields were steady to higher at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering of two billion riyals worth of one-month to one-year treasury bills, bankers in Saudi Arabia said on Tuesday.

The yield on 28-day bills climbed to 5.7890 percent from 5.7257 and the rate on 91-day bills was steady at 5.8572. The 182-day paper yielded an unchanged 5.9207 percent and the rate on 364-day bills rose to 6.1731 percent from 6.1557.
One-month deposit rates were quoted at 5-15/16, 13/16 percent, three months 6-0/0, 5-7/8 percent, six months at 6-1/16, 5-15/16 percent and one year at 6-5/16, 3/16 percent.
The bills were priced at 99.55176, 98.54102, 97.09375 and 94.12500 respectively. -- Bahrain newsroom 973-524424
